claims.claim: PAN 2 is described as an open-source world model that generates realistic driving scenes including a driver waiting at a red light.
claims.episode_span: PAN 2 is an open-source world model, which means a free AI system that can generate entire scenes and predict how they will change based on your actions, like a driver stopping at a red light or a police chase through a wet alley.
claims.supporting_quote: PAN 2 also generated a scene you'll never see in GTA: a driver actually waiting at a red light lol

claims.claim: A 35-year-old SNES console runs a version of ChatGPT accelerated by a Super FX 2 chip.
claims.episode_span: The original Super Nintendo from 1990 just got an upgrade that lets it run a tiny version of ChatGPT. Researchers used a special add-on chip called the Super FX 2 to speed things up enough for the old hardware to handle simple AI conversations.
claims.supporting_quote: 35-year-old SNES runs ChatGPT, accelerated with a Super FX 2 chip

claims.claim: Metaculus predicted May 2035 for the Riemann Hypothesis, LEAP Superforecasters gave a 10% chance in 2026, and Terrance Tao suggested 2050.
claims.episode_span: Metaculus predicted May 2035, LEAP Superforecasters gave only a 10 percent chance of another Millennium problem being solved in 2026, and Tao suggested some combination of humans and AIs around 2050.
claims.supporting_quote: Predictions made last MONTH (post Navier-Stokes) about when the Riemann Hypotheses would be solved: Metaculus: May 2035 LEAP Superforecasters: 10% chance of additional Millennium problem being solved in 2026. Terrance Tao: “some combination of humans and AIs in 2050 or something"
